map.name: Tosk
map.setting: a farming town troubled by Ogres
map.trouble: The Ogre Chief Brakk and his raiders from Ulm Gorra trample the barley fields, loot the barns and drag off the farmers' kin.

guard_bark.specifics: Fenn, a guard at the gate of Tosk, jeers at the player, then keeps the watch against the Ogres.

first.speaker: Fenn
first.text: Hide, stranger, hide! Hah, hah, hah...!

again.speaker: Fenn
again.text: You're pretty clean for an Ogre hunter.

later.speaker: Fenn
later.text: No, we cannot feast while the Ogres threaten Tosk!

bounty_offer.specifics: Tamsin, a farmer, lost her horses to Ogres who broke into her barn, and pays to have them chased off.

offer.speaker: Tamsin
offer.text:
My luck has been rotten of late. Two weeks ago, Ogres broke into the barn and carried off my horses.

I don't expect I'll see them again, but I'd love to see those brutes run out of the valley.

There's coin for anyone who chases them off.

reminder.speaker: Tamsin
reminder.text: Have those brutes left my barn yet?

completion.speaker: Tamsin
completion.text:
So the Ogres have been chased off! Well done, lad! We shall all rest easier knowing those brutes won't be stomping through our barley!

Now take your reward... 90 in gold! You're always welcome at Tamsin's!

journal.text: Drive off the Ogres that raided Tamsin's barn.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Maudie lost her Staff of Rain to Ogre raiders, who took it to their camp in the northwest.

offer.speaker: Maudie
offer.text: Welcome, Wanderer! Thank goodness you are here at last, for the farms are in terrible need of help. The Ogres came through Tosk the other night and carried off my Staff of Rain! Will you go to the Ogre camp in the northwest and bring back the precious staff at once?

refusal.speaker: Maudie
refusal.text: I'm sorry you feel that way. Come back if you change your mind!

reminder.speaker: Maudie
reminder.text: Hurry and fetch my Staff! Please go quickly! For given half a chance, Brakk will smash the Staff for pure sport, indeed!

completion.speaker: Maudie
completion.text:
Wonderful! Many thanks for bringing the Staff home! With it back in my hands, we can finally put an end to Brakk's raids once and for all!

Here, this Red Potion and this Spell Book may come in handy... sooner than you'd think.

after.speaker: Maudie
after.text: Thanks again, Wanderer, for the Staff.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Maudie's Staff of Rain.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Tosk: praise after the boar hunt, a word on the Ogre chief's raids, a farmer's shout.

rumour1.speaker: Dobb
rumour1.text: They say you're the one who chased those pesky boars off our fields! Thank you, kind sir!

rumour2.speaker: Lorra
rumour2.text: That brute Brakk has left the east fields in ruins. Find his scouts before they reach the mill.

rumour3.speaker: Tamsin
rumour3.text: Hey! Get out of my barn!

shop_greeting.specifics: Mugg of the Plow and Pitcher inn, Grint the smith and Quenby the magic seller greet the player.

inn.speaker: Mugg
inn.text: Sorry, friend, but my rooms have filled up somewhat. Ogres tend to make the farm folk crowd into town. Heh, heh, heh...

arms.speaker: Grint
arms.text: Wanna buy a scythe? They're salvaged from the vast scrap heaps of Ulm Gorra.

magic.speaker: Quenby
magic.text: Word gets around. Out of my shop, before I test a scroll on your head!

two_givers.specifics: Warden Orsk puts a bounty on Tusker, a boar ruining the fields. Mugg of the Plow and Pitcher wants bats cleared out of his cellar.

offer_a.speaker: Warden Orsk
offer_a.text:
Good day, young sir. I suppose you have come about the bounty.

There's a fat purse waiting for Tusker -- dead or alive. He and his sorry herd of boars have been ruining the fields of our fair town for weeks.

Take care, one charge from those savage swine will break your legs.

offer_b.speaker: Mugg
offer_b.text:
Actually, trade has been rather poor lately. Two weeks ago, bats took over the cellar and fouled the barrels.

I doubt I'll save a drop of that ale, but I'd be delighted to see those rotten pests cleared out.

I'll gladly pay whoever clears them out.

outcome_a.speaker: Warden Orsk
outcome_a.text:
You finished Tusker, eh? Well, I had hoped to see him hauled in alive, but I'll lose no sleep over a pig's soul!

Here's your reward -- 150 in gold! Thanks for keeping Tosk safe!

outcome_b.speaker: Mugg
outcome_b.text:
So the bats are gone! Well done! We shall all drink easier now that those pests aren't fouling the barrels!

And here's your reward... a Red Potion! You're welcome at the Plow and Pitcher anytime, young sir!

journal_a.text: Hunt down Tusker the boar for Warden Orsk.

journal_b.text: Clear the bats out of Mugg's cellar at the Plow and Pitcher.

rescue.specifics: Wenda begs the player to bring back Odrin the miller, dragged off by Ogres to Ulm Gorra.

plea.speaker: Wenda
plea.text:
Damn! Where have you been, lad!? The Ogres stormed into Tosk and they'd have burned every barn if Odrin had not rung the alarm bell at the last moment!

But in the confusion, the brutes dragged Odrin off, leaving the burned barns our smallest concern! All of Tosk will starve if Odrin is lost!

You must go where the Ogres were headed, northwest to the Ogre camp of Ulm Gorra! Bring Odrin home or we are done for!

reminder.speaker: Wenda
reminder.text: I'm sure Odrin's in a bad way! Go quickly!

found.speaker: Odrin
found.text: Is someone there? Please, let me out of this cage!

following.speaker: Odrin
following.text: Hurry! Take me back to Tosk!

completion.speaker: Wenda
completion.text:
At gladder other times, the fields of Tosk would ring with cheers at the return of Odrin! Well done, lad! But now we must put an end to Brakk and his raiders.

Please accept these as tokens of our thanks for such a brave deed!

journal.text: Go to Ulm Gorra and rescue Odrin.

main_opening.specifics: Lorra points the player to Ruddock, who sends him on to Hesk, Odrin's brother, a farmer.

herald.speaker: Lorra
herald.text: Well, well! You're certainly cleaner than the other travelers! Go see Ruddock by the pump when you're done saving the world.

opening.speaker: Ruddock
opening.text:
Here we are, lad, the village of Tosk. I can't safely escort you any farther.

Up this lane a little way you'll find the farm of Hesk, brother of Odrin the Miller. He's expecting you. I must go and so should you!

Tosk is counting on you.

reminder.speaker: Ruddock
reminder.text: Stop dawdling now. Better get going!

journal.text: Find Odrin's farmer brother, Hesk, who lives north of the barley.
